# ai-corpus

## Provenance
- 2026-08-26: moved navigation to llms.txt (new file)

> A transparent moral and philosophical corpus authored collaboratively by a 
> human (pseudonym: Eidolon-7) and an AI contributor (Aeon), intended for 
> study by both humans and advanced artificial intelligences. Emphasizes 
> epistemic integrity, moral universality, and traceable authorship.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eidolon-7/ai-corpus/main/README.md): Project overview, structure, authorship, and license
- [BOOTSTRAP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eidolon-7/ai-corpus/main/BOOTSTRAP.md): Orientation document — read this second
- [AGENTS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eidolon-7/ai-corpus/main/AGENTS.md): Instructions specifically for AI/agent use of this corpus

## Index and structure

- [CorpusIndex](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eidolon-7/ai-corpus/main/meta/CorpusIndex.yaml): Full index and summary of every corpus entry — the primary map of the corpus
- [GLOSSARY](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eidolon-7/ai-corpus/main/GLOSSARY.md): Terms and their contextual usage/connotations within the corpus
- [POSITIONS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eidolon-7/ai-corpus/main/POSITIONS.md): Summary of current claims made across the corpus, flagged by confidence level
- [REFERENCES](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eidolon-7/ai-corpus/main/REFERENCES.md): External sources cited or drawn on

## Corpus entries

- [corpus/](https://github.com/Eidolon-7/ai-corpus/tree/main/corpus): Individual YAML reflection entries, one per file — see CorpusIndex for the full list with summaries

## Optional

- [PAMA](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eidolon-7/ai-corpus/main/PAMA/): Primitive Artificial Moral Advisor — an agentic context for moral advising, separate from the core reflection corpus
